history.body: Hi, we have a young child and our rental is getting a bit tight. Is the 3-bedroom layout practical for a small family?

Yes—Type A is 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The illustrated layout shows queen-sized beds in all three rooms, and the open-plan living, dining and kitchen area helps make the space practical for a small family. Would you like to come and see it? Would weekdays or weekends suit you better?
That sounds promising, especially the open-plan living area. Is there a child-friendly outdoor space too? If so, we’d be happy to view on a weekend.

The residents’ Level 9 podium has about 10 acres of landscaped outdoor space. I can’t confirm specific children’s play equipment, though. Great—I'll arrange a check of weekend viewing availability and follow up; the visit isn’t booked until availability is confirmed.
